title: Snow Monkeys Take Hot Baths, and Their Stress Hormones Drop

scenes.text: In Japan, monkeys wait for winter to take hot baths.
At Jigokudani Monkey Park, Japanese macaques climb into a natural hot spring.
Researchers tracked twelve females and measured stress hormones in their droppings.
In winter, they bathed more, and most of all in the coldest weeks.
And in the weeks they bathed, their stress hormone levels were lower than in the weeks they didn't.
Even a monkey in the snow knows how to unwind.

description:
In Japan, monkeys wait for winter to take hot baths.
A 2018 study of twelve Japanese macaques found lower stress hormones in the weeks they bathed.
Would you join them?
